data.gender_notes: Jameerah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jameerah is an Arabic name for a female. It means 'protectress' or 'guardian'. In Islamic tradition, Jameerah symbolizes a loving and protective mother or a devoted caretaker. The name Jameerah carries the meaning “Protectress, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jameerah usually hope their child will grow to embody protectress, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rooted in the spiritual bond between a mother and her child in Islam.
data.etymology: Jameerah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protectress, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jameerah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
